verses.text: Haxo ix Raquel chi' ix pitzwicha'anh ajk'olal t'a spensar ix, ix och ix ajk'olal t'a ix Lea chi' yujto malaj yune' ix, ix yalan ix t'a winh yetb'eyum chi' icha tik: --Ak' wune'. Tato ma'ay, tik tzin chami, xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal winhaj Jacob, ix yalan winh t'a ix icha tik: --¿Tokwal Dios hin? Ha Dios chi' max ak'anlaj une' chi', xchi winh.
Ix yalanxi ix t'a winh: --Wayanh yet' ix hin criada Bilha, ayik ol aljok yune' ix chi', icha wal wune' ol ajok, xchi ix.
Ix yak'an ix scriada ix chi' t'a winh, ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix.
Haxo ix alji jun yune' ix Bilha chi',
ix yalan ix Raquel icha tik: Dan ol sb'i'ej winh unin tik, yujto ix yab' hin lesal Dios, ix hin sch'olb'itani, yuj chi' ix yak' jun unin tik t'ayin, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alji junxo yune' ix Bilha yet' winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix yalanxi ix Raquel chi': Ha jun unin tik Neftalí ol sb'i'ej, yujto ix hin telaj hin b'a yet' ix hin nulej ix Lea, haxo tikne'ik ix kan ix yalanh wu'uj, xchi ix.
Haxo yik ix yilan ix Lea to manhxalaj yune' ix, ix yak'anpax ix scriada ix, haton ix Zilpa t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix alji jun yune' ix yet' winh.
--Wach' wiko' yuj chi' Gad swak' sb'i'ej winh unin tik, xchi ix Lea chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alji junxo yune' ix Zilpa chi' yet' winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix yalanpax ix Lea chi' icha tik: Te tzalajk'olal wiko', haxo heb' ix wetixal ol alanok to ay hin tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' Aser ol sb'i'ej winh unin tik, xchi ix.

Ay jun k'u ix b'at winhaj Rubén b'eyel'ek' t'a kaltak te', ayik wan sjochchaj ixim trigo. Hata' ix ilchaj juntzanh sat ank'ultak yuj winh to sloji, mandrágora sb'i. Ix yik'anb'at anh winh t'a ix Lea, haton ix snun winh. Haxo yik ix yilan anh ix Raquel chi', ix yalan ix t'a ix Lea icha tik: --Tzin tewi t'ayach to tzak' junok anh mandrágora ix yik'kot winh une' chi' t'ayin, xchi ix.

Ix yalan ix Lea chi' icha tik t'a ix: --¿Tom manh k'okb'ilok ix ik'ek' winh wetb'eyum, haxo tikne'ik, snib'ej ha k'o'ol tza k'anek' anh mandrágora ix yik'kot winh wune' tik? xchi ix. --Ak' anh t'ayin, tato icha chi' syal sway winhaj Jacob het'ok t'a jun ak'wal tik, xchi ix Raquel chi'.

Haxo yik wan sk'ik'b'i ix jax winhaj Jacob t'a smunlajel, ix b'at ix Lea schakot winh, ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik ol hach way wet'ok, t'a wal yel ix wak' anh mandrágora ix yik'kot winh wune' t'a ix hin nulej ix Raquel ha tojolok, xchi ix. Yuj chi' ix way winhaj Jacob chi' yet' ix t'a jun ak'wal chi'.
Ha Dios ix ab'an slesal ix, yuj chi' ix alji junxo yune' ix yet' winh, yo'il uninxo.
Ix yalan ix: Isacar ol sb'i'ej winh unin tik, yujto ix spaktzitej Dios t'ayin, yujto ix wak' ix hin criada t'a winh wetb'eyum, xchi ix.
Ixlajwi chi', ix alji junxo yune' ix yet' winhaj Jacob chi', haton swakil unin heb'.
Ix yalan ix: Ix yak' Dios jun silab' manhxo jantakok swach'il t'ayin, yuj chi' ol hin sxajanej winh wetb'eyum tik. Swakilxo jun unin tik swil yet' winh, yuj chi' Zabulón ol sb'i'ej, xchi ix.
Yikxo slajwub'al ix yilan sat jun ix unin ix, Dina ix yak' ix sb'i'ej.
Haxo ix Raquel chi', ix nachajkot ix yuj Dios, ix ab'ji slesal ix yuj, ix jawi yune' ix.
Ayik ix alji jun sb'ab'el unin ix, ix yalan ix: Ha hin k'ixwelal, toxo ix yik'el Jehová, yujto toxo ix yak' jun wune' tik.
Tzok wal el t'a sk'o'ol syak'pax junokxo wune', xchi ix. Yuj chi' José ix sb'i'ej jun unin chi' yuj ix.
Ayik toxo ix alji winhaj José, ix yalan winhaj Jacob t'a winhaj Labán icha tik: --Ha tikne'ik, cha hin pax t'a hin chonhab'.
Ak' heb' wuninal yet' heb' ix wetb'eyum, k'okb'ilokxob' hin kajan heb' ix t'ayach, smojxo wal tzin paxi. Ojtak wal tas ix aj hin munlaj t'ayach, xchi winh.
Haxo ix yalan winhaj Labán chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Ma'ay, tzin tewi t'ayach to wach'nhej ajek' wet'ok, yujto ix hin na'eli to hu'ujnhej ay swach'k'olal Jehová t'a wib'anh.
Al t'ayin jantak wal tzach hin tupu', xchi winhaj Labán chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Jacob chi': --Ojtak wal tas ix aj hin munlaj het'ok yet' tas ix aj wilan nok' ha molb'etzal nok' tik.

Ojtak to jaywannhej nok' ha molb'etzal nok' tik ayik hin janak, haxo tikne'ik toxo ix k'ib' sb'isul nok'. Atax wal yik hin janak chi' syamannakoch Jehová yak'an swach'k'olal t'a ib'anh. Haxo tikne'ik, ¿b'ak'inh ol hin cha'el yich wilan wik yet' heb' ix wetb'eyum tik yet' heb' wuninal? xchi winh.
--¿Jantak ha tojol tza k'ana'? xchi winhaj Labán chi'. --Malajokab' hin tojol tzak'a', anhejto swil jab'okxo nok' ha kalnel tik, tato ol scha ha k'o'ol tas ol wala'.
Cha hin och t'a skal nok' ha kalnel yet' nok' ha chiwa tikne'ik, yik tzin sik'anel masanil nok' tz'ib'iltak, nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul, nok' yunetak k'ik'ik'. Ha nok' chi' ol och hin tojolok.

Yuj chi' jun, ayik tzach k'och il nok' ha nok' chi', nok' swik' hin tojolok chi', icha chi' ol aj ilankot hin tojolal. Tato ha t'a skal nok' wik chi' ay nok' chiwa, ma nok' kalnel chi' manh tz'ib'iltakok, mato manh k'ik'ik'ok, wan hach welk'an syal chi', xchi winh.
--Wach'okab'i. Scha hin k'o'ol tas tzal chi', xchi winhaj Labán chi'.

Hanhejtona' t'a jun k'uhal chi' ix sik'anel masanil nok' mam chiwa tz'ib'iltak winhaj Labán chi' yet' nok' jaskiltak stz'ib'ul, nok' nun chiwa soman jab'ok sakil yet' masanil nok' kalnel k'ik'ik' yilji, ix yak'an nok' winh t'a heb' yuninal.
Ix yik'anb'at nok' heb' yuninal winh chi' t'a najat, oxe' k'uhal stek'nab'il b'aj ix kan winhaj Jacob chi'. Ix kannhej winh stanhwej juntzanhxo nok' skalnel winhaj Labán chi'.

Elanhchamel ix sna'a winhaj Jacob chi', ix stzepel sk'ab'tak te te' skuch álamo winh, te' almendro yet' te' castaño. Tz'ib'iltak ix yutej te' winh sjosan stz'umal. Ay sak yet' k'ik'ik' ix aj yilji te' yuj winh.

Ix yak'anoch juntzanh te' k'ab'tak te' chi' winh t'a yichanh nok' kalnel chi', b'aj syuk'a' nok', haton ta' stajni nok'. T'a yichanh nok' aypaxoch te te' tz'ib'iltak yilji chi', yuj chi' ayik tz'aj yune' nok', tz'ib'iltak yilji yune' nok' chi'.
Ha masanil nok' tz'ib'iltak tz'aj chi', ix sik'kanel nok' winh t'a skal nok' yik winhaj Labán chi'. Icha chi' ix yutej winh sik'anel nok' skalnel chi' t'a skal nok' yik winhaj Labán chi'.
Masanil nok' te wach', ayik stajni nok', syak'anoch te te' winhaj Jacob chi' t'a yichanh nok' b'aj xit'ek' nok' yuk'a', yik wach' syil te te' chi' nok' ayik stajni nok' chi'.
Haxo yik sjawi nok' yatak wal ay, max yak'em te te' chi' winh t'a yichanh nok'. Yuj chi', ha nok' tz'ontak yik winhaj Labán chi', haxo nok' wach' yik winhaj Jacob chi'.

Icha chi' ix aj yoch winhaj Jacob chi' b'eyumal. Manh jantakok nok' swakax winh, nok' skalnel winh yet' nok' schiwa winh. Manh jantakok nok' scamello winh yet' nok' sb'uru winh yet' pax heb' winh schekab' winh yet' heb' ix schekab' winh.
